title: Tech Note: Introducing the HIGHLIGHT RECORDS command

historical_commentary.text: The HIGHLIGHT RECORDS command introduced in 4D v6.5 was a significant UI enhancement allowing programmatic record selection in output forms, enabling fully keyboard-driven database interfaces. This command still exists in modern 4D and remains conceptually relevant, though the broader UI paradigm has shifted toward list boxes, ORDA entity selections, and web-based interfaces that make the classic output form pattern less central.
related_updates: HIGHLIGHT RECORDS remains available in current 4D versions
List boxes have largely supplanted classic output forms for record display and selection
ORDA entity selections provide a modern alternative for programmatic record manipulation
